name: support-widget
title: Support Widget
description: Docked support chat with home, messages and conversation views: kai-panel chrome, kai-tab-bar navigation, kai-view-stack routing and the headless conversation controller over local storage. Ships with a scripted mock so the thread demos reasoning and a tool call on first paint.
docs: Runs against a scripted local mock out of the box - no endpoint, no key. The transport is one file, support-widget.transport.ts: the scripted mock in the default mode, a POST to /api/chat with --gateway, a loud stub with --no-mock. Replace it with your own to go live, and keep parsing through the @kitn.ai/ui/wire readers. The host page content is a stand-in: keep the docked panel, and the surrounding page is yours.
